pr_title: feat: Add support for product imports

comments.body: The downloadable template is semicolon-delimited (`Product Id;Product Handle;...`). The backend parses uploads with `convertCsvToJson` (packages/core/utils/src/csv/csvtojson.ts:9), which calls `csv2json` with only `preventCsvInjection` set. The delimiter is therefore json-2-csv's default, a comma. A user who downloads this template and uploads it unchanged gets each row parsed as a single column named `Product Id;Product Handle;...`. The summary will be wrong, or the product-parsing step will fail. The header and rows should be comma-separated, which is also what the export produces.

Behaviour regression: the removed `NotificationFile` showed `file?.filename ?? file.url` and used `download={file.filename ?? Date.now()}`. The new call passes `filename={data.file.filename ?? ""}`. When a notification has a `url` but no `filename`, the label is now blank. In `FilePreview` (file-preview.tsx:78) `filename ?? Date.now()` never falls back, because `""` is not nullish, so the link gets `download=""`. The fallback to the URL for display and a timestamp for the download name is lost.
